feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 8 August 2026 4:23pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 08 August 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred over eastern Europe and low pressure near Iceland as a waving frontal zone affects the northwest of the British Isles.


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, but variable 2 to 4 in the southeast of the area at first, veering west or southwest 3 or 4 in all waters overnight, falling variable in places later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the west at first.


##Weather##

Fair, then occasional rain or drizzle soon arriving.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest, veering northwest through the evening, mainly 3 to 5, decreasing 3 or 4 overnight into Monday, becoming variable 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming smooth or slight later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle quickly clearing to become fair.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
